name: Big Game Dominoes
description: Big Game Dominoes is a western domino connecting game played with an expanded set to support larger layouts and longer tactical exchanges.

overview.description: Big Game Dominoes is a western domino connecting game played with an expanded set to support larger layouts and longer tactical exchanges.

history.origins: The game belongs to modern western domino connecting traditions that favor larger tile sets for extended interaction and scoring potential.
timeline: Modern period: circulated through rules collections and social table play.
history.cultural: Used as a social competitive domino format where longer rounds are preferred.
history.evolution: Expanded set usage distinguishes it from classic double-six lines.

setup.dealing: Tiles are dealt by player count; remaining tiles may form a boneyard under table profile.
setup.equipment: Domino set and score tracking if playing match format.

rules.objective: Be first to empty your hand or finish with the strongest blocked-hand outcome by remaining pips.
rules.gameplay: Players place legal matching tiles to open ends of the layout. If blocked, they follow draw-or-pass handling defined by the table profile. The deal ends on first empty hand or complete block.
keyRules: Tiles must match legal open ends.
Blocked turns are resolved by the active draw-or-pass profile.
Hand end is either first-out or full block resolution.

strategy.basic: Preserve flexible pip coverage in your hand.
strategy.intermediate: Track exhausted values to anticipate forced blocks.
strategy.advanced: Shape the layout to create low-probability responses for opponents.
tips: Do not burn highly flexible connectors too early.
Keep at least one emergency response for tight endgame turns.

synthesis.shortDescription: Big Game Dominoes is a double-8 connecting domino format designed for broader layouts and longer tactical rounds.
